core.name: accounts
core.description: Local account root; an offline account works without a remote identity.

core.name: devices
core.description: Per-account sync writer identity; never a hardware advertising identifier.

core.name: settings
core.description: Typed preferences; key material belongs in Keychain, never this table.

core.name: consents
core.description: Append-only grant/revoke acknowledgements and permission history.

core.name: sync_outbox
core.description: Atomic, idempotent outbound mutation envelopes; health values stay in this store.

core.name: sync_cursors
core.description: Opaque cursor advances only in the same transaction as all applied pull changes.

core.name: sync_conflicts
core.description: Keep both remote and local candidates until an explicit deterministic or user resolution.

core.name: attachments
core.description: Encrypted-file manifest with a same-store typed owner; no image bytes in sync logs.

core.name: series_registry
core.description: Allowlisted query key and unit contract, never arbitrary executable SQL.

core.name: event_registry
core.description: Allowlisted event types for charts and the shared in-memory timeline.

core.name: events
core.description: Typed annotations; Stack events are never copied to the core database.

core.name: daily_rollups
core.description: Rebuildable per-series, local-day, dimension aggregates; missing values remain missing.

core.name: chart_preferences
core.description: Independent per-chart range, transforms, hidden numbers and marker preferences.

core.name: notification_jobs
core.description: Local schedule state; fixed IDs allow cancel/reschedule without duplicate alerts.

core.name: muscles
core.description: Body-map region taxonomy and original/license metadata.

core.name: equipment
core.description: Searchable equipment and bar definition; masses are canonical kg.

core.name: gyms
core.description: Gym profile and active plate calculator context.

core.name: plate_inventory
core.description: Integer plate counts per gym; matched pairs and fractional plates remain exact entered values.

core.name: exercises
core.description: Original/licensed exercise definitions plus private custom records; merge preserves old IDs.

core.name: exercise_aliases
core.description: Indexed aliases include user names without rewriting historical exercise IDs.

core.name: exercise_muscles
core.description: Fractional muscle attribution used by set counting and swap ranking.

core.name: exercise_equipment
core.description: Equipment requirements and optional per-gym setup notes.

core.name: set_types
core.description: User-defined set labels and independent volume/hard-set/PR inclusion switches.

core.name: routine_folders
core.description: Routine organization without deleting archived history.

core.name: routines
core.description: Reusable routine definition; program position can use these routine days before P1 programming.

core.name: routine_exercises
core.description: Ordered routine steps, superset/circuit groups and per-exercise defaults.

core.name: routine_sets
core.description: Editable target sets and warm-up ramps, expressed without programme prose.

core.name: training_schedule
core.description: Calendar plan, rest days, RRULE, missed handling and automatic programme position.

core.name: workouts
core.description: Durable resumable session identity and subjective finish summary.

core.name: workout_exercises
core.description: Session exercise ordering and grouping; swapping records both original and selected exercise.

core.name: workout_sets
core.description: Stable set identity; the selected immutable revision is the current projection.

core.name: set_revisions
core.description: Append-only complete set snapshots. Branches are preserved rather than silently overwriting.

core.name: rest_timers
core.description: Persisted timer deadlines survive app termination; notifications schedule from ends_at.

core.name: pr_records
core.description: Rebuildable records linked to the exact set revision and documented calculation method.

core.name: muscle_targets
core.description: User-set weekly neutral target bands, not clinical recommendations.

core.name: food_sources
core.description: Dataset licensing, attribution, provenance and freshness.

core.name: restaurants
core.description: Preserves the current restaurant library identity during shadow copy.

core.name: foods
core.description: Canonical per-100g food definitions; private corrections link to the original food.

core.name: food_servings
core.description: Household measures, default serving and exact input display units.

core.name: nutrients
core.description: Versioned nutrient identifiers with their actual canonical dimension and reference source.

core.name: food_nutrients
core.description: Per-100g values with source units retained; missing is not zero.

core.name: food_component_groups
core.description: Existing customizable restaurant builder groups; unrelated to dose units.

core.name: food_components
core.description: Restaurant options/modifier references and explicit portion capabilities.

core.name: meal_slots
core.description: Four initial slots plus unlimited private slots and local times.

core.name: meal_logs
core.description: Meal-level notes, photos, hunger/mood, planned/eaten state and clone provenance.

core.name: food_logs
core.description: Immutable-source nutrition snapshot editable only for this log; preserves exact serving entry.

core.name: food_log_nutrients
core.description: Micronutrient and supplement snapshots for diary totals independent of future catalog edits.

core.name: recipes
core.description: Recipe provenance, portions and explicit raw/cooked mass yield.

core.name: recipe_ingredients
core.description: Ordered ingredient mass and entered units for deterministic recipe totals.

core.name: meal_templates
core.description: Saved meal identity, independent from logs or originals.

core.name: meal_template_items
core.description: Reusable ordered meal portions.

core.name: hydration_logs
core.description: Water, caffeine and alcohol quick logs with canonical volume/mass and beverage calories.

core.name: supplement_logs
core.description: Non-peptide supplement log; amounts are food mass and optional nutrients, not injection protocols.

core.name: safety_acknowledgements
core.description: Immutable explicit acknowledgements; no silent floor overrides.

core.name: nutrition_targets
core.description: Calculated/default target snapshots with safety inputs, BMR method and entered goal rate.

core.name: target_overrides
core.description: Per-day or weekday targets and weekly flex budget with the same safety gates.

core.name: diet_phases
core.description: Cut/bulk/maintenance, refeed and diet-break schedule; no dose references.

core.name: weigh_ins
core.description: Canonical kg and original entered representation, including Health source identity.

core.name: measurements
core.description: Named/custom circumference or composition measurement with method and location.

core.name: check_ins
core.description: Current progress notes/photos and subjective recovery scores; optional weight linkage.

core.name: health_samples
core.description: Deduplicated provider observations for weight/steps P0 and recovery P1.

core.name: health_anchors
core.description: Per-type incremental Health cursor; saved atomically with samples/deletions.

core.name: goals
core.description: Cross-domain goal lines and dated targets; core accepts no Stack domain data.

core.name: notes
core.description: Dated private annotations with typed references to core entities only.

core.name: import_batches
core.description: Dry-run/reconciliation manifest for external formats and non-destructive SwiftData shadow copies.

core.name: legacy_id_map
core.description: Stable UUIDv4/SwiftData identity to UUIDv7 translation, without changing the source store.

core.name: export_jobs
core.description: Private full-fidelity JSON/CSV bundle manifests and deletion-request handoff status.

core.name: programs
core.description: Program identity needed to start/resume a programme day; generic user-authored structure only.

core.name: program_days
core.description: Ordered programme day points to its routine without copying authored programme text.

core.name: cached_insights
core.description: Rebuildable deterministic insight facts with exact input provenance for the Why sheet.

core.name: nutrition_days
core.description: Explicit day-completeness status; a food entry alone does not establish a complete day.

core.name: sync_context
core.description: Private transaction-scoped remote-apply suppression; must reset before commit.
